four-together.name: Ezine ndawonye
four-together.seoTitle: Umdlalo wokuhlanganisa izithombe wabantu abadala: Ezine ndawonye
four-together.h1: Ezine ndawonye: umdlalo othulile wokuhlanganisa izithombe
four-together.description: Ezinye izithombe zinendikimba efanayo, njengezithelo noma isimo sezulu. Thepha ezihambisana. Umdlalo wamahhala, othulile wokuhlanganisa ngaphandle kwesikhathi nengcebo.
four-together.short: Thola izithombe ezihambisana, njengezithelo noma isimo sezulu.
four-together.intro: Isethi encane yezithombe, futhi ezinye zazo zihambisana: mhlawumbe izinhlobo ezine zezithelo, noma izindlela ezine zokuhamba. Thepha ezabelana ngendikimba efanayo. Bhekani izithombe ndawonye nixoxe ngento eziyifanayo.

color-match.name: Ukufanisa imibala
color-match.h1: Ukufanisa Imibala: Thola Izithombe Zombala Owodwa

color-match.short: Thola zonke izithombe ezinombala ofanayo nalowo obonisiwe.
color-match.players: 1 noma 2 abantu, noma umuntu omdala nomntwana
color-match.intro: Kubonakala ingxenye enkulu yombala negama lawo elibhalwe eceleni kwayo, futhi ngaphansi kwayo kukhona izithombe ezine noma eziyisithupha. Sebenzisa amagama akho uma uthanda. “Utamatisi” noma “isibhakabhaka” kuhle njengo “bomvu” noma “luhlaza”.

color-by-number.seoTitle: Ukugcwalisa ngokwezinombolo: Umdlalo Wokugcwalisa Onokuthula Ngemibhalo Emikhulu
color-by-number.h1: Ukugcwalisa ngokwezinombolo: Gcwalisa Izikwele, Noma Yimuphi Umbala Othandayo
color-by-number.description: Ukhetho lwezikwele ezinkulu ezinezinombolo nesikhombisi semibala emine ngamagama ayo. Khetha umbala, bese ucindezela izikwele ukuze uzigcwalise. Noma yimuphi umbala uyatholakala, akukho sikhathi noma amaphoyinti, kanti inkinobho igcwalisa okusele ngokwezinombolo. Kuyamahhala ukudlala nokuphrinta.

color-by-number.intro: Ukhetho lwezikwele ezinkulu, ngayinye inenombolo, kanti phezu kwayo kukhona isikhombisi semibala emine, ngayinye inenombolo yayo negama layo elibhaliwe. Khetha umbala esikhombisini, bese ucindezela izikwele ukuze uzigcwalise. Ukhetho lusuke kwi-4 ngu-4 ukuqala, kanti i-6 ngu-6 kanye ne-8 ngu-8 uma ufuna izikwele eziningi. Lapho zonke izikwele zinombala wenombolo yazo, ukhetho lufana nesithombe esisephepheni. Izikwele ezigcwaliswe ngemibala engafani nalena yisithombe sakho siqobo, kanti umdlalo awusho lutho ngakho. "Gcwalisa ngezinombolo" igcwalisa zonke izikwele ezingenalutho ngawe.
howTo: Khetha usayizi wokhetho. 4 ngu-4 inezikwele ezinkulu kakhulu futhi yeyona elula.
Bheka isikhombisi esiphezu kokhetho. Umbala ngamunye unenombolo negama, njengo-1 Okwesibhakabhaka.
Cindezela umbala esikhombisini, bese ucindezela izikwele ozifisa ukuzigcwalisa ngawo.
Sebenzisa umbala ohambisana nenombolo, noma noma yimuphi umbala othandayo. Kokubili kuyatholakala.
Cindezela "Gcwalisa ngezinombolo" zezikwele ezingenalutho, "Sula" ukuqala kabusha ukhetho, noma "Esinye isithombe" ukuze uthole esinye.
tips: Hlalani ecaleni komunye nomunye niphendukelane: omunye akhethe umbala, omunye acindezele isikwele.
Xoxani ngemibala: "Ngiyawuthanda uhlaza." Akudingeki ukuthi kutshiwo ukuthi isithombe sizoba yini.
Esikrinini esincane ukhetho lwe-8 ngu-8 luyaskrola luye ngakwesokudla nesokunxele ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yalo. Izikwele zihlala zinosayizi ophathekayo.
Inguqulo yephepha nayo isebenza, ngamapensela etafuleni eliseduze nombhede.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphoyinti, inkomba yezinyathelo noma ukuphulukisa. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi kuyindlela elungile yokuqeda.

faq.q: Kuthiwani uma ngisebenzisa umbala ohlukile kunenombolo?
faq.a: Akukho okwenzekayo, futhi yileyo ngqikithi. Noma yimuphi umbala ungafakwa kunoma iyiphi isikwele, kanti umdlalo awusho lutho ngakho. Lapho zonke izikwele zinombala wenombolo yazo, umdlalo uyakutshela ngobumnene, kanti isithombe ngemibala yakho siyanele ngokufanayo.

faq.q: Ingabe abantu abanobuthakathaka bokubona imibala bayawabona ahlukene amabala amane?
faq.a: Ahlelwe ukuze abe njalo. Umbala ngamunye unenombolo, igama elibhaliwe nesimo sawo esincane, ngakho umbala awusoze waba yindlela kuphela yokuwahlukanisa. Amabala amane ahlolwe ngokulinganisa ubuthakathaka bokubona ukubomvu nokuluhlaza kanye nokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nomsuka, futhi nawo ahluke ngokukhanya. Umuntu onobuthakathaka bokubona imibala akakawazami, ngakho sicela usitshele uma amabili efana.

faq.q: Ingabe izikwele zinkulu ngokwanele ngezandla ezinyikinyekayo noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Isikwele ngasinye sinobubanzi bamapheseli angu-48 ngaphansi, kanti angu-56 ekhethweni le-4 ngu-4. Uma ukhetho lubanzi kakhulu esikrinini, luyaskrola luye ngakwesokudla nesokunxele ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yalo kunokuba lunciphise izikwele.
Yebo. Ishidi elilodwa linokhetho lwezinombolo nesikhombisi semibala emine ngamagama ayo. Gcwalisa isikwele ngasinye ngophensela wombala ofanayo nenombolo yaso, noma noma yimuphi umbala othandayo.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, kanti akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Lisebenza kwi-iburawuza yewebhu kwifoni, ithebulethi noma ikhompyutha.

pattern-maker.name: Umenzi wephethini
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Umenzi wephethini: Dizayina ithayili bese uphrinta ephethini
pattern-maker.h1: Umenzi wephethini: Dizayina ithayili, uyibone iphinda
pattern-maker.description: Shintsha izikwele zethayili elincane bese ubukela iphinda ibe yephethini ecaleni kwayo, ngemibala emine egama layo nesimo sayo. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphoyinti. Kuyamahhala ukudlala nokuphrinta.
pattern-maker.short: Shintsha izikwele zethayili elincane bese ubukela iphinda ibe yephethini.
pattern-maker.players: Abantu aba-1 noma aba-2, besebenzisana ecaleni komunye nomunye
pattern-maker.intro: Ithayili elincane lezikwele ezi-3 ngezi-3, noma ezi-4 ngezi-4 uma ufisa, kanti ecaleni kwalo kukhona "ephethini yakho": ithayili elifanayo liphindwa ngokwesakhiwo. Cindezela isikwele sishintsheke siye embaleni olandelayo kwemibala emine, ngayinye inegama layo elibhaliwe nesimo sayo. Ephethini eseduze nayo ishintsha ngokushesha. Akukho ephethini efanele, futhi akukho okulondolozwayo noma okuthunyelwayo. "Phrinta ephethini yami" ibeka ephethini ephindiwe ekhasini elilodwa ukuze uyigcine, uyidaye noma uyinikeze omunye.
howTo: Bheka ithayili nephethini yakho ecaleni kwalo. Ngithi ithayili elifanayo, eliphindiwe.
Cindezela isikwele. Sishintsha sibe umbala olandelayo kumugqa wemibala emine ongaphezulu.
Qhubeka ucindezela izikwele uze ephethini ibonakale njengoba ufisa. Noma yiphi ephethini ilungile.
Cindezela "Ngimangalise" ithayili elisha, noma "Qala kabusha" elicacile. "Buyisela" ibuyisela ithayili wawunalo.
Cindezela "Phrinta ephethini yami" uma uyifuna ephepheni, noma cindezela Phumula ukuze umise.
tips: Hlalani eduze komunye nomunye nithathe amathuba: omunye acindezele isikwele, omunye athi yini ayibonayo.
Khulumani ngalokho enikubonayo: "Lokho kufana nembali." Akudingeki ukuthi nitshele igama lalutho.
Zama ithayili efanayo ngemibala emibili kuphela, bese uphinda ngemibala yonke emine.
Ephepheni, iphethini ingadayiswa ngamapensela, isikwe ibe yimichilo yekhadi, noma isetshenziselwe ukusonga isipho esincane.

faq.a: Cha. Alikho iwashi, amaphuzu, isibali sokunyakaza noma ukulahleka. Ungayeka noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi nendlela kuyindlela elungileyo yokuqeda.

faq.q: Ingabe into engiyenzayo iyagcinwa noma iyathunyelwa?
faq.a: Cha. Ithayili yakho ihlala kule khasi kuphela. Ayigcinwa, ayilayishwa, futhi ayibalwa, futhi iyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi. Uma ufuna ukugcina iphethini, yishicilele.

faq.q: Kuthiwani uma ngicindezela isikwele esingalungile noma ngisula ithayili ngephutha?
faq.a: Akukho isikwele esingalungile: sicindezele futhi ukuze uye embaleni olandelayo. Emva kwe-"Qala kabusha" noma "Ngimangalise", "Ngibuyisele" ibuyisela ithayili ebeyinayo.

faq.q: Abantu abanokungaboni imibala kahle bayakwazi ukuzihlukanisa lezi mibala emine?
faq.a: Zakhethwa ukuze zibe njalo. Umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhalwe, nesimo sawo esincane kwisikwele ngasinye, ngakho umbala awusiyo kuphela indlela yokuzihlukanisa. Lezi mibala emine zahlolwa ngokulinganisa ukungaboni kahle ngokubomvu nangokuluhlaza, nangokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka nangokuphuzi. Umuntu onokungaboni imibala kahle akakazizami, ngakho sicela usitshele uma ezimbili zifana.

faq.q: Ingabe izikwele zinkulu ngokwanele ngenxa yokungcangcazela noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Isikwele ngasinye singaba ngamapikseli angu-56 ubude ubuncane. Uma ithayili ibanzi kakhulu kwisikrini, isunduzela ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yayo, kunokuba izikwele zinciphe.
Yebo. "Shicilela iphethini yami" ishicilela iphethini oyenzile ekhasini elilodwa, ngemibala emine namagama ayo. Ibonakala kahle ngomnyama nomhlophe, ngoba umbala ngamunye unesimo sawo.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu kufoni, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

drawing-duet.name: Ukudweba ngababili
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Ukudweba Ngababili: Abantu Ababili, Isithombe Esisodwa
drawing-duet.h1: Ukudweba Ngababili: Abantu Ababili, Iphepha Elilodwa
drawing-duet.description: Abantu ababili bathatha amathuba bedweba imigca esicelweni esisodwa esabelwanayo, ngalunye ngombala wakhe. Akekho owaziyo amaphuzu noma owinayo, futhi isithombe singagcinwa noma singashicilelwa. Ukudlala kuyamahhala, akudingeki i-akhawunti.
drawing-duet.short: Thatha amathuba udwebe isithombe esisodwa nomuntu oselecaleni lakho.
drawing-duet.intro: Icansi elilodwa, abantu ababili. Ngalunye lenu likhetha umbala, futhi umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhalwe. Niyathatha amathuba: dweba umugca noma isimo esisodwa, bese udlulisa ipeni. Omunye wenu angadlulisa ipeni noma nini. Akukho isithombe esilungile futhi akukho amaphuzu. Gcina isithombe kudivayisi yakho uma ukuthanda, noma shicilela inguqulo yephepha: iphepha elilodwa, amapeni amabili.
howTo: Ngalunye lenu likhetha umbala. Ibhana litshela ukuthi ithuba ngubani, nombala waleyo muntu ngegama.
Dweba umugca noma isimo esisodwa ngomunwe, ngemawusi noma ngepeni. Noma sebenzisa amakhiye omcibisholo kanye nokhiye we-Space ukudweba ngaphandle kwesikhombi.
Uma usulungele, cindezela "Dlulisa ipeni". Omunye wenu angadlulisa noma nini.
Cindezela "Thatha umugca wami wokugcina" ukususa umugca omusha kakhulu womuntu osebenza ithuba.
Cindezela "Gcina isithombe" ukwenza ifayela lesithombe kule divayisi, noma "Shicilela inguqulo yephepha" ngephepha elilodwa namapeni amabili.
tips: Hlalani eduze komunye nomunye nikhuluma njengoba nidweba: "Ngizofaka ilanga ekhoneni."
Qala ngechashazi, ngomugca noma ngesimo esilula, bese omunye wenu aphendula kwalokho.
Akekho onesidingo sokudweba isithombe sanoma yini. Iphethini yemigca ilungile njengesithombe sendawo.
Uma ufuna ukuyeka, cindezela "Kwanele okwamanje". Isithombe sakho asigcinwa ngemuva kokuphuma ekhasini, ngaphandle kokuthi usigcinile.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho mphumeleli, akukho amaphuzu, akukho sikhathi nokubala kwamathuba. Akukho isithombe esilungile, futhi akukho okuhlelwa noma okuqhathaniswa.
Cha, akukho lutho oluthunyelwa. Isithombe sihlala kule khasi kuze uvale. Uma ucindezela "Gcina isithombe", kudalwa ifayela kudivayisi yakho ongalidawunilodi. Akulayishwa lutho.
Yebo. "Thatha umugca wami wokugcina" usula umugca omusha kakhulu womuntu osebenza ithuba. "Qala kabusha" usula ikhasi, futhi "Ngibuyisele" ibuyisela imigca, inyathelo elilodwa kuphela.

faq.q: Ngingasebenzisa lokhu ngaphandle kwemawusi noma isikrini sokuthinta?
faq.a: Yebo. Lapho idweba ligxile, amakhiye omcibisholo ahambisa ichashazi lepeni, nokhiye we-Space ubeka ipeni phansi noma uliphakamise. Isikrini sithi "Ipeni liphansi" noma "Ipeni liphakeme" njalo lapho kwenzeka lokho.

faq.q: Yimibala yini, futhi abantu abanokungaboni imibala kahle bayakwazi ukuzihlukanisa?
faq.a: Iphuzi, iorenji, eluhlaza nepaphula, imibala emine efanayo esetshenziswa ezinye izithombe zethu zemidlalo. Umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhalwe, futhi amagama abonakala eduze kwethuba. Imibala yahlolwa ngokulinganisa okuvamile kokungaboni imibala kahle, kodwa umuntu onokungaboni imibala kahle akakayizami.

Yebo. "Shicilela inguqulo yephepha" ishicilela iphepha elilodwa linemithetho phezu kwalo, nesakhiwo esikhulu esingenalutho sokudweba kuso, ngabantu ababili namapeni amabili. Isebenza ngomnyama nomhlophe.
Ja, dit is gratis, en daar is geen rekening, registrasie of aflaai nodig nie. Dit werk in die webblaaier op 'n foon, tablet of rekenaar.

build-together.name: Bou saam
build-together.seoTitle: Bou Saam: Twee Mense Bou Een Patroon
build-together.h1: Bou Saam: Twee Mense, Een Rooster
build-together.description: Twee mense wissel af om 'n stuk in 'n gedeelde rooster te sit totdat dit vol is, elkeen met 'n eie kleur wat 'n naam en 'n vorm het. Niemand wen nie, en daar is geen tydopnemer of telling nie. Gratis om te speel en te druk.
build-together.short: Wissel af met iemand langs jou om een gedeelde rooster te vul.
build-together.intro: 'n Gedeelde rooster van 4 by 4 plekke, of 3 by 3 as jy wil. Elkeen van julle kies 'n kleur, en elke kleur het sy eie geskrewe naam en vorm. Julle wissel af: op jou beurt tik jy 'n leë plek om jou stuk daar te sit. Wanneer elke plek 'n stuk het, is die prent saam gebou. Daar is geen wenner nie, omdat julle dit as 'n paar maak, en niks word gestoor of gestuur nie. "Druk die rooster" plaas 'n leë rooster op een bladsy sodat julle met twee potlode kan bou.
howTo: Elkeen van julle kies 'n kleur. 'n Kleur wat die ander persoon het, word as "In gebruik" gemerk.
Die eerste persoon begin. Die skerm sê wie se beurt dit is en watter kleur hulle s'n is.
Tik 'n leë plek om jou stuk daar te sit. Die beurt gaan oor na die ander persoon.
As jy liewer nie 'n stuk wil sit nie, tik "Slaan oor". Enige van julle mag enige tyd oorslaan.
Wanneer elke plek 'n stuk het, het julle die prent saam gebou. Tik "Begin weer" om nog een te bou, of tik Rus om te stop.
tips: Sit langs mekaar sodat julle albei die skerm kan sien en daarby kan. Praat terwyl julle werk: "Ek sit myne langs joune."
Probeer 'n patroon bou, strepe, 'n dambord of 'n rand, of plaas net stukke waar jy wil. Albei is goed.
'n Kind of iemand wat maklik moeg word, kan so dikwels as wat hulle wil oorslaan. Die prent word steeds saam gebou.
Op papier gebruik elkeen een potlood en teken hul eie vorm in die leë vierkante.

faq.q: Is daar 'n wenner, 'n tydopnemer of 'n telling?
faq.a: Nee. Daar is geen wenner nie, omdat julle een prent saam bou. Daar is geen klok, telling, aantal stukke of verloor nie. Jy kan op enige oomblik stop, en halfpad stop is 'n heeltemal goeie manier om klaar te maak.

faq.q: Word enigiets wat ons maak gestoor of gestuur?
faq.a: Nee. Die rooster bly net op hierdie bladsy. Dit word nie gestoor, opgelaai of getel nie, en dit verdwyn wanneer jy die bladsy toemaak. As jy dit wil hou, druk die rooster en bou op papier.

faq.q: Wat as ek 'n stuk op die verkeerde plek sit?
faq.a: Daar is geen verkeerde plek nie. Tik "Neem die laaste stuk terug" en die beurt gaan terug na jou. Jy kan een stap op 'n slag terugneem, en 'n oorslag kan ook teruggeneem word.

faq.q: Kan mense met kleurblindheid die vier kleure van mekaar onderskei?
faq.a: Hulle is so gekies. Elke kleur het ook 'n geskrewe naam en sy eie klein vorm in elke stuk, so kleur is nooit die enigste manier om hulle te onderskei nie. Die vier kleure is nagegaan met simulasies van rooi-groen- en blou-geel-kleurblindheid. 'n Persoon met kleurblindheid het hulle nog nie probeer nie, so laat ons asseblief weet as twee soos mekaar lyk.

faq.q: Is die plekke groot genoeg vir 'n bewing of 'n klein skerm?
faq.a: Elke plek is minstens 56 pixels breed. As die rooster te breed is vir die skerm, rol dit sylangs binne sy eie kassie in plaas daarvan dat die plekke krimp.
Ja. "Druk die rooster" druk 'n leë rooster op een bladsy met die twee kleure en hul name, sodat julle met twee potlode kan bou. Dit werk in swart-wit omdat elke kleur sy eie vorm het.

faq.q: Is dit gratis, en moet ek registreer?
faq.a: Ja, dit is gratis, en daar is geen rekening, registrasie of aflaai nodig nie. Dit werk in die webblaaier op 'n foon, tablet of rekenaar.

seated-toss.name: Sittende gooi-telling
seated-toss.h1: Sittende Gooi-telling: Gooi Saam aan 'n Tafel
seated-toss.description: Twee mense aan 'n tafel wissel af om 'n sagte boontjiesak in 'n groot teiken te gooi en hou die telling op papier. Niks word getyd of getel nie. Gratis om te druk.
seated-toss.short: Wissel af om 'n boontjiesak na 'n groot teiken te gooi, met die telling op papier.
seated-toss.intro: 'n Rustige gooispel vir twee mense wat aan 'n tafel sit. Jy lê 'n gedrukte teiken op die tafel en wissel af om 'n sagte boontjiesak, of 'n opgerolde sok, te gooi sodat dit op die ringe land. Elkeen van julle hou 'n telling bi by met merkies in kassies op papier, en julle kyk saam na die merkies wanneer julle stop. Niks word getyd nie, niks word op die skerm opgetel nie, en niks word gestoor of gestuur nie. Lees asseblief eers die veiligheidsnotas: klein vulsels is 'n verstikkingsgevaar.
howTo: Lees die veiligheidsnotas. Kies 'n sak met 'n toegenaaide bedekking, of rol 'n skoon sok op.
Tik "Druk die teiken en telblad" en lê die blad plat op die tafel tussen julle.
Sit gemaklik, een aan elke kant, en wissel af met een sagte gooi elk. Enigiemand mag oorslaan.
Wanneer 'n gooi in 'n ring land, merk 'n kassie in jou kolom, op die ry vir daardie ring.
Kyk saam na die merkies wanneer julle stop, of tik Rus om te pouseer.
tips: Hlala useduze ngokwanele ukuthi ukuphosa okuthambileyo ngaphansi kwesandla kufinyelele esikhangisweni ngaphandle kokweluka.
Khuluma ngokuphosa, hhayi ngesiphumo: "Lokho bekuthambile." Wonke umuntu uyancoma ukuphosa ngakunye.
Isokisi eligoqiweyo liyakhanya futhi lilula ukubamba ngesandla esibuthakathaka. Beka ingalo etafuleni phakathi kwezikhathi zokudlala.
Uma omunye emethanda ukubukela, angaba yilowo oyimaka amabhokisi.

faq.a: Hayi. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, inombolo yezinyathelo noma ukulahlwa. Ungayima noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi nendawo kuyindlela elungileyo yokuqeda.

Kungaba njalo, uma unakekela. Sebenzisa isikhwama esinesivalo esihlanganisiwe noma isokisi eligoqiweyo, hhayi amabhontshisi, irayisi noma izinto ezincane ezingaphakathi, okuyingozi ngokubamba kubantwana abancane nakubo bonke abafaka izinto emlonyeni. Hlala phansi, uphose ngobumnene etafuleni futhi ungaphosi ebusweni, futhi gcina umuntu omdala eduze.

faq.q: Kukhona yini okubalwayo noma okugcinwayo esikrinini?
faq.a: Hayi. Ukubalwa kutholakala kuphepha kuphela, emabhokisini eniwamaka ngokwenu. Ikhasi aligcini sibalo nesikhathi, futhi akukho okugcinwa noma okuthunyelwa.

faq.q: Kuthiwani uma umuntu engakwazi ukuphosa, noma isikhwama sehla ngaphandle kwephepha?
faq.a: Noma ubani angadlulisa ithuba, futhi isikhwama esehla ngaphandle kwephepha sithathwa nje sibe yithuba elilandelayo. Akukho okubalwa ngaso.

Ikhasi elilodwa: isikhangiso esikhulu esinemibhobo emithathu egcinwe amagama ngokuthi Eduze, Phakathi naKude, ithebula elinekholomu yomuntu ngamunye nomugqa wamabhokisi amancane okuzokumakwa ngawo imibhobo, kanye nomugqa wezeluleko zokuphepha. Amagama abhalwe emibhobeni, ngakho kusebenza nasemnyameni nasemhlophe.
Yebo, kumahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu efonini, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

seasonal-pack.name: Iphakethe lamapuzzle ezikhathi zonyaka
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Iphakethe Lamapuzzle Ezikhathi Zonyaka: Amapuzzle Wephepha Alishicilelekayo
seasonal-pack.h1: Iphakethe Lamapuzzle Ezikhathi Zonyaka: Amapuzzle Amathathu Ephepha Ngesikhathi Ngasinye
seasonal-pack.description: Amapuzzle amancane amathathu alishicilelekayo ngentwasahlobo, ehlobo, ekwindla noma ebusika: hlanganisa amapheya, ungqinge isithombe esehlukile, uphinde ufake umbala esithombeni. Khetha isikhathi, noma uthathe usuku lokuphumula. Kumahhala ukushicilela.
seasonal-pack.short: Amapuzzle amathathu alishicilelekayo esikhathini osikhethayo, noma usuku lokuphumula.
seasonal-pack.players: Zonke izinkathi zobudala, wedwa noma ecaleni komunye
seasonal-pack.intro: Khetha isikhathi, bese ikhasi libonisa amapuzzle amathathu amancane wephepha asuselwa ezithombeni zalesosikhathi: imigqa emibili yokuhlanganisa ngemigqa, umugqa wezithombe ezine ukuze ungqinge esehlukile, nesithombe sokufaka umbala. Ushicilela ikhasi elilodwa, bese wenza elilodwa, elimbili noma lawo mathathu, ngesivinini sakho. Khetha "Namuhla ngusuku lokuphumula" esikhundleni salokho, bese kungekho okufanele wenze.
howTo: Khetha isikhathi, noma khetha "Namuhla ngusuku lokuphumula".
Bheka amapuzzle amathathu, bese uthepha "Shicilela iphakethe lalesi sikhathi".
Wenza elilodwa, elimbili noma lawo mathathu, ngesivinini sakho.
Hlanganisa izithombe ezifanayo ngomugqa, ungqinge esehlukile, bese ufaka umbala esithombeni esikhulu.
Yima noma nini othanda. Usuku lokuphumula nalo lusuku elihle.

Khuluma igama ngalinye lesithombe ngelizwi eliphakeme, uma kusiza.
Sebenzisa izinkwebela noma amapensela. Noma yimaphi amabala ayamukeleka.
Gcina ikhasi ngesikhathi esizayo, noma liyeke.

faq.a: Hayi. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, inombolo yezinyathelo noma ukulahlwa. Ungayima noma nini, futhi ukuyeka phakathi nendawo kuyindlela elungileyo yokuqeda.

faq.q: Ikhasi liyazi yini ukuthi sikhathi sini?

find-together.seoTitle: Vind Saam: Twee Mense Vind die Pare
find-together.h1: Vind Saam: Twee Mense, Een Span
find-together.description: Twee mense deel een skerm en wissel af om twee prentkaarte om te draai en 'n paar te soek. Pare word saam gevind en op een gedeelde telling aangeteken. Gratis om te speel, sonder tydmeter of telling.
find-together.short: Wissel af met iemand langs jou om die prentpare te vind.

scrapbook.name: Incwadi yezithombe
scrapbook.seoTitle: Incwadi Yezithombe: Phendulani Izithombe Zomndeni Ndawonye, Ikhasi Ngekhasi
scrapbook.h1: Incwadi Yezithombe: Engeza Izithombe Zakho Namagama, Bese Uphendula Amakhasi
scrapbook.description: Khetha izithombe ezingu-bili kuya kwezilishumi nambili zomndeni wakho esidivayisini sakho, uphendule njengencwadi, namagama ambalwa ngaphansi kwesithombe ngasinye. Akulayishwa lutho. Kuyamahhala ukushicilela.
scrapbook.short: Phendulani izithombe zomndeni wakho ndawonye, njengencwadi.
scrapbook.players: Wedwa, noma abantu ababili eceleni komunye nomunye
scrapbook.intro: Khetha izithombe ezingu-bili kuya kwezilishumi nambili zakho kulesi sidivayisi. Isithombe ngasinye siba yiphepha elilodwa encwadini, likhulu ngokwanele ukuze libonakale, negama elingaphansi kwalo elingakhethwa. Phendulani amakhasi ngamaconsi noma izinkinobho ze-arrow ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla, futhi sebenzisa "Bukani ndawonye" ukuhlala eceleni komunye nomunye nezithombe namagama kuphela. Izithombe zakho zihlala kulesi sidivayisi. Azilayishwa noma azigcinwa, futhi incwadi iyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi. "Imprinta incwadi yezithombe" iprinta isithombe negama laso ekhasini ngalinye, namanombolo amakhasi.
howTo: Thepha "Khetha izithombe" uke ukhethe izithombe ezingu-bili kuya kwezilishumi nambili. Buza ngaphambi kokusebenzisa isithombe somuntu ongakwazi ukuvuma.
Phendula amakhasi ngo-"Ikhasi elidlule" no-"Ikhasi elilandelayo", noma ngezinkinobho ze-arrow ngakwesobunxele nakwesokudla.
Engeza amagama ambalwa ngaphansi kwesithombe uma uthanda. Sebenzisa "Hambisa ngaphambili" noma "Hambisa ngemuva" ukushintsha uhlelo.
Thepha "Bukani ndawonye" ukufihla izinkinobho zokuhlela, bese nibukana eceleni komunye nomunye.
Thepha "Imprinta incwadi yezithombe" ukuthola ikhophi yephepha, noma "Sula incwadi" uma useqedile. Akukho okugcinwayo.
tips: Wähle Fotos von Dingen, die fröhlich und vertraut sind: ein Garten, ein Haustier, ein Lieblingsort. Erzählen Sie beim Umblättern über jede Seite.
Lassen Sie die Person zu jeder Seite ein paar Worte sagen, auch nur ein einziges Wort, und schreiben Sie sie genau so auf, wie sie gesagt werden.
Auf Papier können die gedruckten Seiten in einen Ordner gelegt werden, und die Familie kann eigene Bilder und Notizen rundherum ergänzen.

Ja. "Scrapbook drucken" druckt auf jeder Seite ein Foto und seine Bildunterschrift, mit Seitenzahlen. Wählen Sie im Druckdialog A4 oder US Letter.

collage-board.name: Collagen-Brett
collage-board.seoTitle: Collagen-Brett: Zwei Personen legen abwechselnd Bilder auf ein Brett
collage-board.h1: Collagen-Brett: Bilder abwechselnd auf einem Brett platzieren
collage-board.description: Zwei Personen legen abwechselnd ausgeschnittene Bilder auf ein gemeinsames Brett. Tippen Sie auf ein Ausschnittbild und dann auf einen leeren Platz. Kein Timer, keine Punkte. Kostenlos zum Spielen und Drucken.
collage-board.short: Legen Sie abwechselnd Bilder auf ein gemeinsames Brett.
collage-board.intro: Zwei Personen sitzen nebeneinander vor einem Brett mit zwölf Plätzen und einer Ablage mit acht ausgeschnittenen Bildern. Tippen Sie auf ein Ausschnittbild und dann auf einen leeren Platz, dann kommt das Bild dorthin. Danach ist die andere Person an der Reihe. Die Bilder jeder Person haben eine eigene Form, einen Kreis oder ein Quadrat, sodass das Brett zeigt, wer was gelegt hat, ohne sich auf Farben zu verlassen. Jede Person darf aussetzen, und ein Schritt kann zurückgenommen werden. Nichts wird gestoppt, bewertet oder gespeichert. "Brett drucken" druckt das leere Brett und die Bilder zum Ausschneiden.
howTo: Tippen Sie in der Ablage auf ein Ausschnittbild. Solange es ausgewählt ist, steht dort "Ausgewählt".
Tippen Sie auf einen leeren Platz auf dem Brett. Das Ausschnittbild kommt dorthin, und die Reihe wechselt.
Jede Person kann jederzeit auf "Aussetzen" tippen oder auf "Letztes Bild zurücknehmen", um einen Schritt rückgängig zu machen.
Tippen Sie auf "Anderer Bildersatz" für eine andere Ablage. Bilder, die schon auf dem Brett liegen, bleiben dort, wo sie sind.
Tippen Sie auf "Neu beginnen", um das Brett zu leeren, und auf "Zurücklegen", wenn Sie es sich anders überlegen.
tips: Nennen Sie den Namen jedes Bildes, wenn es gelegt wird, zum Beispiel "die Teetasse kommt neben das Haus". Das Sprechen macht die Aktivität zu einer gemeinsamen Sache.
Lassen Sie die beiden Personen abwechselnd das Ausschnittbild und den Platz wählen, damit jede ein Mitspracherecht hat.
Auf Papier: Schneiden Sie die acht Bilder mit Hilfe eines Erwachsenen aus und legen Sie sie dann auf die gedruckten Felder.

faq.q: Woran erkennen wir, welches Bild wem gehört?

coloring-wall.seoTitle: Udonga Lokudweba Lweqembu: Isithombe Esisodwa Ngezandla Eziningi
coloring-wall.h1: Udonga Lokudweba Lweqembu: Isithombe Esikhulu Esisodwa, Sidwetshwe Ndawonye
coloring-wall.description: Phrinta isithombe esikhulu esisodwa emakhasini amaningi, ukuze umndeni, ikilasi noma indlu yokunakekela idwetshe udonga olulodwa ndawonye. Kuyamahhala ukuphrinta. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu.
coloring-wall.short: Phrinta isithombe esikhulu emakhasini ukuze abantu abaningi bakudwetshe.
coloring-wall.intro: Khetha isithombe emakhasini okudweba, nodonga lwamakhasi amali-4, 6 noma 9. Phrinta udonga: ikhasi lokuqala libonisa ukuthi kulihlanganiswa kanjani, namanye amakhasi ngamanye amakhasi esithombe esisodwa esikhulu, nelebula njengo-A1 ekhoneni lawo. Umuntu ngamunye udweba ikhasi elilodwa noma amaningi, ngemibala nangesitayela esifisayo. Amakhasi abe esehlelwa ngelebula zawo aphinde ahlanganiswe ngetheyiphu ngasemuva. Akulinganiswa ngesikhathi, akunikezwa amaphuzu, futhi akugcinwa.
howTo: Khetha isithombe, bese ukhetha ukuthi udonga lunamakhasi angaki.
Funda imephu esikrinini, ebonisa ukuthi yiliphi lebula elingena kuphi.
Thepha "Phrinta udonga" uphrinte onke amakhasi.
Nika umuntu ngamunye ikhasi elilodwa noma amaningi ukuze adwetshe. Imibala nezitayela akudingeki ifane.
Hlela amakhasi ngelebula zawo, uwahlanganise ngetheyiphu ngasemuva.
tips: Nika amakhasi anemigqa elula labo abafuna umsebenzi othule, namakhasi anemininingwane eminingi labo abayithokozelayo.
Lenza udonga ludlale lapho wonke umuntu angalubona khona, bese nixoxa ngezingxenye zalo ndawonye.
Khetha udonga oluncane etafuleni elincane, noma oluncane ekamelweni.

faq.q: Amakhasi agcinwa noma athunyelwe noma yiphi indawo?

quiet-shapes.name: Umdlalo wezimo ozolile
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Umdlalo Wezimo Ozolile: Faka Izimo Esithombeni
quiet-shapes.h1: Umdlalo Wezimo Ozolile: Faka Izingcezu Esithombeni
quiet-shapes.description: Faka izimo ezilula ohlakeni lwendlu, isikebhe, intlanzi nezinye. Thepha ingcezu, bese uthepha indawo enesimo esifanayo. Akukho sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Kuyamahhala ukudlala nokuphrinta.
quiet-shapes.short: Faka izimo ezilula esithombeni, ngesivinini sakho.
quiet-shapes.intro: Uhlaka lwesithombe, njengendlu, isikebhe noma irokhethi, luhlukaniswe laba izindawo. Indawo ngayinye inengcezu enesimo esifanayo, unxantathu omkhulu noma omncane, isikwele, iparallelogram noma isikhwama. Thepha ingcezu, bese uthepha indawo enesimo esifanayo, kuyalingana. Indawo iphendula ingcezu ngokwayo, ngakho akukho okudingeka ukuyidonsa noma ukuyijikeleza. Uma ingcezu inesimo esihlukile esigxotsheni, ihlala etreyini nenothi emfushane. Akulinganiswa noma akunikezwa amaphuzu, futhi akugcinwa noma akulayishwa. "Phrinta lesi simo" iphrinta uhlaka nezingcezu zalo ekhasini elilodwa ukuze udwetshe noma usike.
howTo: Thepha ingcezu etreyini. Ibonisa "Ikhethiwe" lapho ikhethiwe.
Thepha indawo esithombeni. Uma isimo sifanayo, ingcezu iyalingana khona.
Uma kungafani, zama enye indawo. Ukuzama akulahlekisi lutho.
Thepha ingcezu esithombeni ukuze uyibuyisele etreyini, noma sebenzisa "Qala kabusha" ukubuyisela zonke.
Lapho zonke izindawo sezinengcezu yazo, isithombe siphelele. Thepha "Esinye isimo" ukuze uthole esisha, noma thepha Phumula ukuze umise.
tips: Vula imigqa yesiqondiso ukuze ubone isikhala ngasinye. Yivala ukuze kube yinkinga enzima kancane, njengoba umbandela kuphela uzakukuqondisa.
Qala ngezimo ezinkulu, njengonxantathu abakhulu namakhonco. Izingcezu ezincane zivame ukubekwa ekugcineni.
Biza ezimo ngelizwi lapho uqhubeka: "unxantathu, isikwele, irektangela elide". Ukukhuluma kungenza lokhu kube umsebenzi wokubambisana.
Ephepheni, phena izingcezu ngemibala emi-2 noma emi-3, noma uzinqume nomuntu omdala asiza.

faq.q: Kukhona isibali-sikhathi, amaphuzu noma inani lezinyathelo na?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho okulinganiswa ngesikhathi, okubalwayo noma okunikezwa amaphuzu. Ingcezu engalingani ayibekwa, futhi ungayeka noma nini ufisa.

faq.q: Ingabe okwenziwayo kuyagcinwa noma kuyathunyelwa na?
faq.a: Cha. Isithombe sihlala kulelikhasi kuphela. Asigcinwa, asilayishwa noma asibalwa, futhi siyanyamalala uma uvala ikhasi.

faq.q: Ingabe izikhala zinkulu ngokwanele zokunyakaza kwezandla noma isikrini esincane?
faq.a: Umbandela udwetshwa ngobukhulu obukhulu kangangoba isikrini sivumela, futhi isikhala ngasinye yinkinobho ongayifinyelela ngomunwe noma ngokhiye we-Tab. Izingcezu ezisesitsheni yizinkinobho ezinkulu zalelikhasi.

Yebo. "Phrinta lo mumo" uphrinta isithombe esisodwa ekhasini elilodwa: umbandela nemigqa yawo yesiqondiso, kanye nezingcezu zidwetshwe ngobukhulu obufanayo ngasecaleni kwawo. Phena izingcezu, noma uzinqume ukuze zilingane. Umuntu omdala angakwenza ukusika.

faq.q: Ingabe kuyamahhala, futhi kudingeka ukubhalise na?
faq.a: Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Kusebenza kwisiphequluli sewebhu kuselula, ethebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

calm-breathing.name: Ukuphefumula ngokuthula
calm-breathing.description: Ukuphumula okuncane nokuthulile ngokuphefumula okwabelwanwa ngakho: umjikelezo omncane ukhula futhi uncipha ngemiphefumulo eyisithupha. Wena uqala, futhi ungayeka noma nini.
calm-breathing.short: Umjikelezo oncane okuphefumula ngawo. Qala uyeke lapho ufuna.
calm-breathing.intro: Ngezinye izikhathi umsebenzi omuhle kakhulu ukuphumula ngokuthula. Cofa "Qala", bese uphefumula ngenkathi umjikelezo ukhula, uphume ngenkathi uncipha. Khetha isivinini esiphansi noma esisheshayo. Akusona ukwelashwa, kuphela ukuphumula okuthulile okwabelwana ngakho.
howTo: Hlala ngokuthula eduze komunye.
Khetha isivinini: esiphansi noma esithambile.
Cofa "Qala". Phefumula ngenkathi umjikelezo ukhula, uphume ngenkathi uncipha.
Uyima ngokwawo ngemiphefumulo eyisithupha, noma cofa "Yima" nanoma nini ofuna.
tips: Bamba izandla noma ubeke isandla esingalweni lomuntu uma kwamukeleka.
Ungaphoqi. Uma befuna ukubukela, kulungile.
Uma umuntu enenkinga yokuphefumula, phefumula njengejwayelekile futhi ubuke umjikelezo. Buza udokotela ngazo zonke izinkinga zokuphefumula.

faq.a: Cha. Kuyikhefu elula, elikhethekayo lokuthula nokuba nomuntu. Akusona ukwelashwa kokukhathazeka noma noma yisiphi isimo. Khuluma nodokotela ngezinkinga zempilo.

faq.q: Umjikelezo unyakaza yini ngaphandle kokuthi mina ngiwuqalise?
faq.a: Cha. Akukho nto ehamba uze uthinte Qala, futhi iyeka emva kokuphefumula isithupha noma uma uthinta Yeka. Uma idivayisi yakho imiselelwe ukunciphisa ukunyakaza, amagama ayashintsha kodwa isiyingi asikhuli.
Yebo, kuyamahala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu kucingo, kuthebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

story-chain.name: Iketanga lezindaba
story-chain.seoTitle: Iketanga Lezindaba: Umdlalo Wezithombe Wezindaba Owabelwanayo
story-chain.h1: Iketanga Lezindaba: Landisa Indaba Isithombe Esisodwa Ngesikhathi
story-chain.description: Umugqa wezithombe ukhula sisodwa ngesikhathi, futhi ngulowo nalowo ushilo umusho ngakho ngokuzwakalayo. Akukho okudingeka ukuthayiphwe, akukho mpendulo engalungile. Kuyamahhala, kuthulile, akukho sibali-sikhathi namaphuzu.
story-chain.short: Engeza isithombe, bese ngulowo nalowo ushilo umusho, ngokuphendulana.
story-chain.intro: Umdlalo uqala ngesithombe esisodwa bese ukhulisa iketanga sisithombe ngasinye ngesikhathi. Ngulowo nalowo ushilo umusho owodwa mayelana neketanga selikhona, ngokuzwakalayo, ngokuphendulana. Umusho ungaba ngalokho obona, indawo ekhumbuza kuyo, noma into ehlekisayo. Akukho okuthayiphwayo, okuqoshwayo noma okugcinwayo, akukho mpendulo engalungile, futhi noma ngubani angadlula. Iketanga limisa ezithombeni ezi-8, bese ningaqala elisha.
howTo: Bhekani isithombe sokuqala ndawonye.
Phendulanani: ngulowo nalowo ushilo umusho owodwa mayelana neketanga selikhona. Noma ngubani angadlula.
Thepha "Engeza isithombe" ukubeka isithombe esilandelayo ekugcineni kweketanga.
Thepha "Susa owokugcina" uma ufisa ukubuyela esithombeni esedlule.
Uma iketanga selinezithombe ezi-8, thepha "Qala iketanga elisha" ukuze uthole elisha, noma yeka nje.
tips: Kuhle ukuba mfushane: "Umuntu ubeke ibhodwe lamanzi." Olandelayo uyaqhubeka, noma uyadlula.
Vumela izithombe ziholele. Akukho sigaba esihloswe ukusifinyelela.
Yeka noma nini ufisa. Ukuyeka phakathi nendawo kuyindlela enhle yokuphetha.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho iwashi, amaphuzu, inani lezinyathelo noma ukulahlekelwa. Ungayeka nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, futhi ukuyeka phakathi nendawo kuyindlela enhle yokuphetha.

faq.q: Ingabe kuthayiphwa noma kuqoshwa into thile na?
faq.a: Cha. Imisho ishiwo ngokuzwakalayo, ayithayiphwa, ayiqoshwa noma ithunyelwe noma kuphi. Umdlalo ubonisa izithombe kuphela.

faq.q: Kuthiwani uma umuntu engafuni ukusho lutho?
faq.a: Noma ngubani angadlula, futhi olandelayo uyaqhubeka. Akekho odingeka ukuthi aqambe noma akhumbule isithombe.

faq.q: Ingabe kuyamahhala, futhi kudingeka ukubhalise na?
faq.a: Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Kusebenza kwisiphequluli sewebhu kuselula, ethebhulethi noma kukhompyutha.

quiet-scene.name: Isimo esithulile
quiet-scene.h1: Isimo Esithulile: Isithombe Esisodwa Esithulile Ngesikhathi
quiet-scene.description: Isithombe esikhulu, esithulile esisodwa ngesikhathi, ngasinye nomugqa omncane ongaphansi kwaso. Cindezela okulandelayo noma okwandulelayo uma usulungele. Akukho okunyakazayo noma okudlalayo ngokwaso, akukho sibali-sikhathi noma amaphuzu. Kuyamahhala, akudingeki i-akhawunti.
quiet-scene.short: Bheka isithombe esisodwa esithulile ngesikhathi, ngesivinini sakho.
quiet-scene.intro: Isithombe esikhulu sigcwalisa isikrini, nomugqa omfushane ongaphansi kwaso. Cindezela "Isithombe esilandelayo" noma "Isithombe esidlule" uma usulungele enye. Akukho okunyakazayo, okufiphalayo noma okushintshayo ngokwaso, futhi akukho sikhathi esibalwayo. Thepha "Isithombe esikhulu" ukubonisa isithombe kuphela, ukuze ilungu lonke lekamelo lisibone kuthelevishini.
howTo: Bhekani isithombe ndawonye.
Funda umugqa ongaphansi kwaso ngokuzwakalayo uma uthanda.
Cindezela "Isithombe esilandelayo" noma "Isithombe esidlule" uma usulungele.
Thepha "Isithombe esikhulu" ukubonisa isithombe kuphela, no-"Bonisa konke" ukubuyisa okunye.
Yeka nini ufisa ngo-"Sekwanele okwamanje".
tips: Vumela umuntu akhethe ukuthi uqhubeke nini: linda ukuthi abheke, bese ucindezela okulandelayo.
Kumqembu, sebenzisa "Isithombe esikhulu" kuthelevishini noma kwiskrini esikhulu, uhlale lapho bonke bangakubona khona.
Akukho indlela efanele yokubheka isithombe. Ukukhuluma ngaso nje kuyumsebenzi ophelele.

faq.a: Cha. Akukho msindo, futhi akukho okunyakazayo, okufiphalayo noma okushintshayo ngokwaso. Isithombe sishintsha kuphela uma ucindezela inkinobho.

color-wash.name: Color wash
color-wash.seoTitle: Color Wash: Umbala Othambile Ekhasini Lonke
color-wash.h1: Color Wash: Dweba Umbala Othambile Ekhasini Lonke
color-wash.description: Ibhulashi elithambile lidweba imibala emikhulu, ekhanyayo ekhasini elilodwa, ngemibala emine nobukhulu bebhulashi ababili. Akukho siphetho, akukho mphumela, akukho sikhathi. Kuyamahhala ukudlala, akudingeki iakhawunti.
color-wash.short: Dweba imibala emithambile ekhasini lonke, ngesivinini sakho.
color-wash.players: Wedwa, noma abantu aba-2 eceleni komunye nomunye
color-wash.intro: Ikhasi elilodwa nebhulashi elilodwa elithambile. Khetha umbala nobukhulu bebhulashi, bese uhudula ekhasini ukuze wenze ukudweba kombala. Ikhasi alinasiphetho: akukho okudingeka siqedwe, akukho isithombe okudingeka sihlelwe kahle, futhi akukho mphumela. Dweba noma yimaphi amadwebo ofuna, noma ubeke ibhulashi phansi ubukele nje. Ikhasi elisha lisusa konke, kanti Buyisela lubuyisela konke.
howTo: Khetha umbala. Umbala ngamunye unegama lawo elibhaliwe.
Khetha Obanzi noma Obanzi kakhulu. Obanzi kakhulu umboza ikhasi eliningi ngokushaya ngakunye.
Hudula ekhasini ngomunwe, ngembewu noma ngepeni ukuze wenze ukudweba.
Noma sebenzisa izinkinobho zomcibisholo ukuhambisa indandatho yebhulashi, kanti i-Space ukubeka ibhulashi phansi noma ukulisusa.
Thepha "Ikhasi elisha" ukuze usule ikhasi, bese "Buyisela" uma ufuna amadwebo abuyele.
tips: Vumela omunye umuntu akhethe umbala wodwebo olulandelayo, nixoxe ngemibala njengoba iyafakwa.
Obanzi kakhulu kulula ukuqondisa ngesandla esiqhayisayo, ngoba ibhulashi alidingi ukuba linembile.
Akukho indlela efanele yokupeyinta. Yeka noma nini ofuna, noma thepha "Kuqedile okwamanje".

faq.a: Cha. Ikhasi alinasiphetho. Akukho okuqedwayo, okubalwayo, okulinganiswa isikhathi noma okunikezwa umphumela, futhi akukho umlayezo oke ukucela ukuthi wenze okwengeziwe.
Cha. Akukho okugcinwayo, okushicilelwayo noma okuthunyelwayo noma kuphi. Amadwebo ahlala kulelikhasi uze uliphume.

faq.q: Ngingasebenzisa lokhu ngaphandle kwesilwane sokuthinta noma isikrini sokuthinta?
faq.a: Yebo. Uma ikhasiligxilile, izinkinobho zomcibisholo zihambisa indandatho yebhulashi, kanti inkinobho ye-Space ibeka ibhulashi phansi noma ilisuse. Isikrini sithi "Ibhulashi phansi" noma "Ibhulashi phezulu" njalo lapho.
Cha. I-watercolor ephepheni yinto efanayo, ibhulashi elimanzi nombala owodwa ngesikhathi, ngakho kuwumsebenzi ohlukile okungazanywa etafuleni.

Okuphuzi, okuwolintshi, okuluhlaza nokuphepuli, imibala emine efanayo esetshenziswa kwamanye amagemu ethu esithombe. Umbala ngamunye unegama elibhaliwe, futhi igama libonakala ngasecaleni kokukhethwa.
Yebo, kuyamahhala, futhi akudingeki kube nensamba, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Kusebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu efonini, ethebhulethini noma ekhompyutheni.
